name: Ashtanga Yoga Athens 2002
reason: Too thin: its own site (ashtangayoga2002.com; robots.txt allows us) has a 2026-27 Mysore timetable but no prices, and its only items with pages of their own are the 2026 weekly retreats (Tunis 24-30 June, Crete 14-20 July, both full and passed) and photo galleries of past workshops (2016-2018). The Saturday introductory seminar and the monthly led class with satsang have no pages. Founded 2002 by Eleftheria Lagoudaki (authorised); email eleftherialagoudaki@gmail.com. Worth revisiting when 2027 retreats are posted.
